name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth

categories.label: Quest of the Ring completed (Frodo at Mount Doom / Nazgul catch Frodo)
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành Quest of the Ring (Frodo tới Mount Doom / Nazgul bắt Frodo)
categories.hint: Immediate win for Fellowship (Ring destroyed) or Sauron (Ring seized).

categories.label: Different Race symbols on your Green cards
categories.labelVi: Số biểu tượng chủng tộc khác nhau trên thẻ Xanh lá
categories.hint: 6 different symbols (Eagle on one Alliance token counts as a symbol) = immediate win.

categories.label: Regions of Middle-earth where you are present
categories.labelVi: Số vùng Trung Địa bạn hiện diện
categories.hint: Fortress and/or at least 1 Unit. All 7 = immediate win; otherwise most regions after chapter 3 wins.

tiebreakers.description: If the chapter-3 region count is tied, the victory is shared.

winCondition: Immediate win by (1) completing the Quest of the Ring, (2) gathering 6 different Race symbols on Green cards, or (3) being present in all 7 regions. If none happens by the end of chapter 3, the player present in the most regions wins; a tie shares the victory.

roles.label: Fellowship of the Ring
roles.winCondition: Frodo and Sam reach Mount Doom (destroy the Ring), or Races or Conquest victory.

roles.label: Sauron
roles.winCondition: Nazgul catch Frodo and Sam (seize the Ring), or Races or Conquest victory.

endCondition.description: Ends immediately on a victory condition, or after chapter 3 with the regions comparison

notes: family: objective-race. No points. Sauron player starts. Fan expansions and solo/automa variants not modelled.

sources.title: Duel for Middle-earth rulebook (Repos Production)
sources.section: p.2 Overview and goal; p.7 End of the game
